```promql
rate(node_processes_forks_rate{node=~"k8s-node[24]", pod_name=~"coredns-558bd4d5db-[a-z0-9]+"}[5m])
```

But please note that the metric `node_processes_forks_rate` is fictional here and must exist in your monitoring system for this query to work. The above query assumes that the `node_processes_forks_rate` metric has labels `node` and `pod_name`, which identify the node name and pod managed by the coredns replicaset, respectively. Also, the `[5m]` range vector selector indicates that the rate calculation should consider the last five minutes of data points.
